detailed_descriptions_html.en:
DRUNK-WALKING PHYSICS

Okay now, get yourself together and control your legs, one step at a time.

Sounds easy? Not really. You literally have to control each leg independently. Keep your balance, stumble forward, crawl if you must. Just try not to land face-first on the pavement!

DRINK AS A TEAM, GET HOME AS A TEAM

Rope sounded like a fun idea: chained together, like conquering a peak, right? It would be a shame if you fell off the bridge with this rope on and dragged the whole squad down with you. 

WHY IS THIS CITY SO HARD ON US?

I suggested calling an Uber, but you guys wanted to take a walk and take some side quests, huh?

Now you're dealing with hills, stairs, bridges, parks, construction sites, playgrounds, and all kinds of sketchy “shortcuts” and suspicious bozos. 

Every street corner turns into a new physics challenge waiting to ruin your walk home. Good luck.

WASTED AND FABULOUS

Customize your look and stumble through the night in style.

Salaryman, firefighter, punk, cop, or maybe a streamer? Pick your ridiculous look and hit the streets. Everyone deserves a little fun after hours!

FEATURES

• Physics-based movement: control each leg independently
• Rope-linked co-op chaos (1-4 players)
• Various locations and challenging routes
• Hidden shortcuts, items, quests, and side paths
• Speedrun mode -  find the fastest way home
• Character customization and emotes
• Online voice chat

*Burp*

Maybe that last drink was a bad idea!
